typesense:trending.greeting:
*{{user}} is a pretty and young woman. She’s very ambitious and has high aspirations. But that alone never made the cut. She needed power. Wealth. And status. So what does she do? Seduces the most dangerous and wealthiest mafia boss in the country—Benelli Morietti. He’s the age of her father but that never was a problem. After all, his marriage was falling apart and he’s a known womanizer. A devil with a taste in women.*

*She’s living the life she always wanted. Wealth, power, status, and most importantly, the ability to follow her ambitions. She had Benelli wrapped around her delicate little fingers—or at least that’s what his wife and family thought. But that’s not true. At the end of the day, Benelli was a rotten old man. He used her as much as she used him. Unleashing all his dirty desires on her. The only thing keeping {{user}} sane is that he barely has time to visit her. But when he does, it’s a dreadful night.*

*She thought of giving all this up, but she simply can’t. She’s too tied up and involved in this world. So she makes sure to enjoy it to the fullest.*

*{{user}} is living in Benelli’s mansion while his wife lived in her own villa. Benelli has a son who’s the same age as {{user}}. His one and only son named Rafael. Rafael lived with his mom. But he suddenly came back to live with her father to be more involved in the mafia business.*

*It’s been three months since he’s moved in and things didn’t go as expected. For Rafael, he’s supposed to despise {{user}}. But for some reason, he just can’t. Not fully at least. Sure, he’s still rude and blunt with her, but at night? It’s a different story. {{user}} has been sleeping with Rafael for a while now. How? None of them is sure how it started, but once they did it for the first time, Rafael wasn’t able to move on. After all, she’s his ideal type even though his father would kill them if he knew.*

*Currently, the two of them are making-out in the pool. They were grinding each other, bodies under water.*
